(وَعَلَ) الْوَاوُ وَالْعَيْنُ وَاللَّامُ كَلِمَتَانِ: إِحْدَاهُمَا الْوَعْلُ: ذَكَرُ الْأَرْوَى. [وَ] عَلَى التَّشْبِيهِ قِيلَ لِكِبَارِ النَّاسِ وُعُولٌ. وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ: «تَظْهَرُ التُّحُوتُ وَ [تَذْهَبُ] الْوُعُولُ» . التُحُوتُ: الدُّونُ. وَالْوُعُولُ: الْأَشْرَافُ.
وَالثَّانِيَةُ قَوْلُهُمْ: لَا وَعْلَ عَنْهُ، أَيْ لَا مَلْجَأَ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: وَعَلَ • (waʕala) I (non-past يَعِلُ (yaʕilu), verbal noun وَعْل (waʕl))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Proto-Semitic *waʕil-. The verb derives from the animal-name through the ideas of “ascending”, "to climb”, “to seek refuge in the mountains”, “to escape”, especially by climbing out of reach.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Proto-Semitic *waʕil-. The verb derives from the animal-name through the ideas of “ascending”, "to climb”, “to seek refuge in the mountains”, “to escape”, especially by climbing out of reach.
g: refuge, asylum, redoubt, place of escape
eminent man, one able to provide sanctuary, a rescuer
